name: Biomech Construct (Psionic)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to manifest astral construct.

Benefit(s): Whenever you manifest astral construct, you may apply the biomech template* to any constructs created by this power. In addition, whenever you select an astral construct menu option, you may instead select an enhancement menu option or abilities menu option of the corresponding level from the metamorphosis line of powers (for example, exchanging an option from Astral

Construct Menu A for an option from Abilities Menu A).
